description: Read one Swiss Living Index dataset (id from list_datasets), exactly as published on the site (official values, unchanged). Filter with canton (2-letter) and/or commune (name or BFS number), section (a top-level key), from_year / to_year. Large datasets return a size summary first so you can narrow the request. Every reply carries source, source URL and the page to cite.

canton.description: Canton as 2-letter abbreviation, e.g. "ZH", "GE", "TI". Filters the dataset to that canton.

commune.description: Swiss commune: official name, BFS number or 4-digit postcode, e.g. "Winterthur", "230" or "8400". «8001 Zürich» and «Basel (BS)» also work. Filters the dataset to that commune.

from_year.description: Keep year series from this year, e.g. 2015.

max_kb.description: reply size limit in KB, default 150, max 600

section.description: One top-level section of the dataset (the too_large answer lists them).

to_year.description: Keep year series up to this year, e.g. 2025.

name: get_dataset
title: Read a dataset
